Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and manage multiple deadlines. title: BIM Modeller PHE
minimumQualification: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical Engineering, Plumbing Engineering , or a related field.
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced BIM Modeler – PHE with 8–10 years of relevant experience in commercial projects . The candidate will be responsible for developing detailed PHE/Plumbing BIM models, preparing drawings and documentation, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring the quality and timely delivery of project deliverables. Develop and maintain detailed PHE/Plumbing BIM models using Revit MEP . Model domestic water supply, drainage, stormwater, sanitary, and other plumbing systems. Prepare plumbing layouts, riser diagrams, schematics, sections, and detailed drawings. Coordinate PHE models with Architectural, Structural, HVAC, Electrical, and Fire Fighting disciplines. Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues using Navisworks or similar BIM coordination tools. Prepare detailed shop drawings, schedules, and documentation as required. Ensure BIM models and drawings comply with project standards, specifications, and BIM Execution Plans. Participate in BIM coordination meetings and collaborate with architects, engineers, BIM coordinators, and other stakeholders. Review models and drawings for accuracy, completeness, and quality. Support the BIM team in resolving technical and modeling-related issues. Maintain model integrity and ensure timely completion of project deliverables. What do we need from you Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical Engineering, Plumbing Engineering , or a related field. 8–10 years of relevant experience in PHE/Plumbing BIM modeling. Strong hands-on experience in Revit MEP and Auto CAD . Good working knowledge of Navisworks and BIM coordination processes. Strong understanding of water supply, drainage, sanitary, stormwater, and plumbing systems . jobDescription:
About Us Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development. Our 22,000 employees operate across over 100 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world. With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers. About the Role The Bid Coordinator carries the operational rhythm of the bid. The role sits at the heart of day-to-day bid delivery
- the seat that owns document control, compliance, scheduling and submission logistics, and runs Simple and Simple Plus pursuits end-to-end where the category calls for it. The Bid Coordinator owns the operational backbone of the tender unit's pursuits. The role establishes the Share Point structure, manages the central inbox and the CRM record, distributes RFP documents and addenda, tracks deliverables against the plan, runs the compliance check against the RFP, and submits the final pack to the client. On Simple and Simple Plus pursuits, the Bid Coordinator runs the bid as the bid runner
- chairing the kick-off, holding the rhythm and delivering the submission. On Medium and Complex pursuits, the Bid Coordinator works alongside the Bid Manager or Senior Bid Manager
- owning compliance, document control, version management, the colour review packs and the final submission logistics. The role works closely with the wider tender unit, with Technical Leads on technical content collation, with Commercial & Pricing on the price pack, and with Graphics on visual production. The Bid Coordinator is the role the rest of the team relies on for the bid to run smoothly. Compliance and RFP Discipline
- Runs the compliance check against the RFP at every stage of the pursuit. Ensures every mandatory requirement is captured, every form completed, every signature in place. Holds the final compliance check before submission. Submission Logistics
- Owns the submission process
- portal upload, email submission, hand delivery, courier where required. Carries the client confirmation and the internal submission notification. Closes the loop on documentation storage and CRM update post-submission. Schedule and Deliverables Tracking
- Tracks deliverables against the bid plan
- owners, dates, status, blockers. Runs the daily, bi-daily or weekly check-ins. Surfaces issues to the Bid Manager or Senior Bid Manager early so they can be resolved before they affect submission. CRM and Share Point Discipline
- Owns the operational accuracy of CRM and Share Point records across every pursuit. Carries the discipline that the rest of the team relies on
- opportunity registration, status updates, document storage, archive
- as the operational standard of the unit. Tender Collateral and Standard Documents
- Owns the standard document pack

title: Senior Integration Team lead - ERP Ecosystem
minimumQualification: Education: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
jobDescription:
About Us Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 22,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation. In the UK we're proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets. From motorways to tramways, and nuclear power plants to smart cities, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges
- delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet. About the Role The Senior Integration Developer is responsible for the development, maintenance, and support of integrations and extensions within the EARTH ecosystem, covering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP/HCM, satellite applications, middleware, reporting, and BI tools. Based in Bangalore and reporting to the Integration Leader, the role contributes to the design, implementation, testing, documentation, and run support of robust, scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions using Oracle Cloud technologies such as Oracle Integration Cloud, VBCS, REST/SOAP APIs, BI Publisher, OTBI, and related data services. Working closely with the Integration Leader, Solution Architect, functional experts, L2/L3 support teams, and external partners, the Senior Integration Developer supports the full Build-to-Run lifecycle and contributes to the stabilization, industrialization, and long-term internalization of Oracle / EARTH Run and Build capabilities. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Integration Development and Maintenance Develop, maintain, and enhance Oracle Fusion Cloud integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, REST/SOAP APIs, VBCS, and related Oracle Cloud technologies. ▪ Implement and maintain CEMLI components, including extensions, interfaces, conversions, reports, and data extracts. Design reusable, secure, scalable, and high-performing integration flows aligned with architecture principles and integration standards. Reports, Extracts and Data Services Develop and maintain reports, extracts, and analytics components using BI Publisher, OTBI, BICC, SQL, PL/SQL, and related reporting tools. Support data transformation, mapping, reconciliation, traceability, and quality control across interfaces and connected applications. Contribute to the reliability and maintainability of data flows across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP/HCM and the broader EARTH ecosystem. Incident Investigation and Run Support Investigate incidents related to interfaces, data flows, reports, integrations, technical extensions, and middleware components. Identify root causes, propose corrective and preventive actions, and contribute to the reduction of recurring incidents. jobDescription:

We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 22,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world. - delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet. About the Role The Solution Architect is responsible for defining, ensuring consistency, and strengthening the robustness of IS architectures within the EARTH ecosystem scope (ERP, HCM, CRM, E-PROD “Project and Portfolio Management” and complementary Saa S solutions). This is a high-visibility role for a transformational leader, offering the opportunity to work extensively with international IT and business high-level stakeholders. Working closely with the ERP Ecosystem Run (L2-L3) Delivery Manager and the Middleware integration leader, the Solution Architect will contribute directly to the stability, performance, and evolution of the EARTH solutions ecosystem, reducing structural incidents, and strengthening end-to-end business process fluidity & data quality. What do we need from you Solution & Technical Architecture • Own the target and existing architecture for the EARTH ecosystem, covering applications, interfaces, data flows and key dependencies across Oracle Fusion ERP, HCM, PPM and satellite solutions. • Define, document and enforce architecture standards, integration patterns, API principles, data-flow models and technical design guardrails. • Ensure end-to-end solution consistency, scalability, security, maintainability and alignment with enterprise architecture principles. Business–IT Alignment • Translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions, working closely with Business Analysts, BPOs, IT leadership and delivery teams. • Support prioritization of technical choices based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency and long-term reusability. • Reduce the gap between business expectations and delivery by clarifying solution options, impacts, constraints and arbitration points. Project Framing, Design and Build-to-Run • Contribute to project framing and design phases, validating integration within the existing ecosystem and anticipating impacts on Run, supportability and performance. • Embed operability, monitoring, documentation and support requirements from the design stage to secure smooth Build-to-Run transition. Challenge customization, duplication and technical complexity to limit technical debt and promote reusable core model capabilities. Contribution to Run and Continuous Improvement • Provide L3 expertise on major incidents and recurring structural issues, identifying root causes related to interfaces, data, dependencies or solution design. • Drive actions to improve IS stability, performance, data quality and end-to-end business process fluidity. • Promote automation, monitoring, knowledge capitalization and AI-assisted practices to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort. Governance and Capitalization • Contribute to sustainable architecture governance across a multi-application, multi-country and multi-stakeholder environment. • Participate in architecture reviews, technical decision-making forums and solution arbitration with Enterprise Architecture and IT leadership. • Establish reliable documentation for architectures, interfaces, data flows, decision records and operational knowledge base content. Essential Experience • Significant experience as a Solution Architect, Lead Architect or Senior Functional/Technical Architect in complex enterprise application environments. • Strong exposure to Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle HCM; experience with Oracle Integration Cloud, OCI and integration architecture is highly expected. • Experience working across Build and Run contexts, including project framing, solution design, support transition, incident analysis and continuous improvement. • Proven ability to operate in international, matrixed and multicultural organizations with both IT and business stakeholders. Technical & Functional Expertise • Deep understanding of ERP, HCM, CRM, PPM and complementary Saa S ecosystems, with the ability to assess dependencies, data flows and integration impacts. • Knowledge of Dynamics 365 CRM B2B is a plus; experience with Planview or comparable PPM solutions is appreciated. • High ownership, curiosity, resilience and capacity to work in a changing environment where documentation and governance are still being strengthened. • Strong command of architecture documentation, interface mapping, data-flow modelling, technical debt management and architecture governance practices. • Good understanding of ITIL-oriented Run processes, especially incident, problem, change, release and knowledge management. Leadership & Soft Skills • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure complex topics, identify root causes and propose pragmatic architecture options. • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to align diverse stakeholders and explain technical matters to senior business and IT audiences. • Balanced strategic and operational posture, combining long-term architecture vision with hands-on pragmatism in Run and delivery contexts. Sucess Metrics Architecture for the EARTH ecosystem is progressively documented, controlled and shared with Run, Build and Enterprise Architecture stakeholders. • Reusable solution patterns, integration standards and data-flow principles are defined and applied across new initiatives. • Structural incidents and recurring root causes linked to solution design, interfaces or data quality are reduced through corrective architecture actions. • Business–IT alignment improves through clearer arbitration, stronger architectural governance and better readability of solution impacts. WORKING CONDITION • Build-to-Run handovers become more reliable, with clear documentation, supportability requirements and operational readiness checks. • Location: Bangalore, India. This is an office-first role; remote work is permitted only on an occasional and exceptional basis. • International Exposure: This role involves frequent collaboration with European time zones and global teams, requiring flexibility and strong cross-cultural communication skills. What's in it for you? •

jobDescription:

In the UK we're proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets. - delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet. About the Role We are seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to establish and run a high-performance Oracle ERP L2/L3 support hub in Bangalore. This is a pivotal leadership role, designed to build a world-class 'support factory' that will progressively become the central pillar of our global Oracle Cloud ERP operations. In this strategic role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our support services, covering critical business functions like Finance, Project Portfolio Management (PPM), and Human Capital Management (HCM). You will lead the recruitment and development of a large team of functional and technical experts, orchestrate a complex knowledge transition from our current partner, and drive operational excellence to ensure we meet and exceed global service level agreements. This is a high-visibility role for a transformational leader, offering the opportunity to shape a new global capability centre and work extensively with international stakeholders. Team Setup & Leadership ▪ Recruit & Scale: Lead the end-to-end recruitment and onboarding strategy to build a team of 25-50 FTEs by the end of 2026, establishing a robust talent pipeline. ▪ Mentorship: Identify, mentor, and develop a Deputy Manager to ensure operational resilience, business continuity, and succession planning. ▪ People Management: Act as the single point of accountability for team performance, capacity planning, workload distribution, and workforce management, including attrition and absence management. ▪ Culture Building: Forge a high-performance team culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to service excellence. Transition & Knowledge Transfer ▪ Structured Transition: Define and execute a comprehensive knowledge transfer plan (3-6 months) from our incumbent service provider, ensuring a seamless and risk-free transition of all support activities. ▪ Progressive Takeover: Lead a phased, parallel-run approach to take full ownership of the support function, validating team readiness and process maturity at each stage. ▪ Documentation & Enablement: Ensure the creation and maintenance of a robust knowledge base, comprehensive system documentation, and training materials to empower the team. Service Delivery & Operations (L2 Support) ▪ End-to-End Service Ownership: Manage the full lifecycle of Oracle ERP support, including: Incident & Problem Management: Ensure resolution aligns with strict SLAs and KPI targets (availability, resolution time, CSAT, etc.). Change & Release Management: Oversee the intake, prioritization, and execution of change requests, including the management of quarterly patching cycles and environment refreshes. Technical Stewardship: Coordinate with middleware, data, and infrastructure teams to manage integrations (APIs, OIC) and ensure system stability. Reporting & Analytics: Manage the delivery of critical reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher, providing actionable insights to stakeholders. Process, Tools & Performance Management ▪ ITIL Framework: Define, implement, and continuously improve ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Level Management). ▪ Tooling & Metrics: Deploy and optimize ITSM tools to automate workflows, enhance reporting, and provide real time visibility into service performance. ▪ Continuous Improvement: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities, eliminating manual processes, and leveraging agentic AI capabilities to enhance efficiency. ▪ Governance & Reporting: Deliver regular, data-driven performance reports to senior leadership and global governance bodies. Stakeholder & Ecosystem Management ▪ Global Interface: Serve as the primary point of contact for global IT leadership, business stakeholders, and European partners, effectively bridging time zones and cultural differences. ▪ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams including Solution Architects, Business Analysts, Middleware, and Data & Infrastructure teams to ensure cohesive service delivery. ▪ Strategic Contribution: Actively contribute to the strategic direction of the Global IT Applications group, positioning the Bangalore center as a key strategic asset. Context & Organizational Positioning • The role is part of a strategic transformation program to build an India-centric GCC model (≈85% India footprint) • The manager is a key operational leader within the Global IT organization • The position interacts daily with international stakeholders, especially in Europe • The organization aims to build long-term internal capabilities and reduce dependency on external vendors What do we need from you

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: 10+ years of total experience, with at least 10+ years in a leadership role managing Oracle ERP support services. Preferred Certification: ITIL v3/v4 Certification; Oracle Cloud certifications (e.g., Financials, HCM) are a significant plus. What's in it for you? ▪ Proven experience in building, scaling, and leading L2/L3 support teams of 20+ FTEs in a global delivery model. ▪ Deep, hands-on experience in managing Oracle Cloud ERP support services, specifically across Finance, PPM, and HCM modules. ▪ Strong background in Application Management Services (AMS) or support factory models. ▪ Demonstrated experience in managing complex transitions or Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) projects, ideally in consulting or system integration firms. ▪ Must have experience collaborating with European stakeholders (Ideally French) and navigating multicultural, matrixed environments. Technical & Functional Expertise Deep Domain Knowledge: Expert understanding of Oracle Cloud ERP (Finance, PPM, HCM) and its underlying architecture. ▪ ITIL Mastery: Strong command of ITIL service lifecycle processes, specifically Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management. ▪ Technical Acumen: Working knowledge of integration technologies (APIs, OIC), environment management, and reporting tools (OTBI, BI Publisher). ▪ SLA Management: Proven track record of managing KPI and SLA-driven support models, with a focus on service quality and customer satisfaction. Leadership & Soft Skills ▪ Structured & Analytical: Strong organizational skills with a data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision making. ▪ Inspirational Leader: A natural people leader with a talent for recruiting, mentoring, and motivating diverse, high performing teams. ▪ Exceptional Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to senior executives. ▪ Strategic & Execution-Oriented: A visionary leader who can define a clear roadmap and also roll up their sleeves to drive execution in a transformation context. ▪ Resilient & Adaptable: Possesses high ownership, accountability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage change effectively. Success Metrics (First 12-18 Months) Successful recruitment, build-out, and stabilization of the Bangalore L2 support team. Seamless and timely completion of knowledge transfer and full operational transition. Achievement of target headcount and operational readiness by the end of
2026. Consistent compliance with defined SLA/KPI targets for service quality and delivery performance. - Lead the design and development of public health systems (water supply, drainage, sanitation, gas) and fire protection systems (sprinklers, hydrants, fire pumps, suppression systems) for building projects.

- Proven leadership and project management skills on large-scale, multidisciplinary projects.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

title: Sr .Traffic & Transportation Engineer
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering / Transportation Engineering (Master’s preferred).
jobDescription:
About Us Great Platform for Talent About the Role Role Overview Lead traffic engineering and transport planning tasks for major infrastructure projects, with a strong focus on Dubai RTA-compliant Temporary Traffic Management (TTM), diversions, and traffic staging, alongside permanent traffic impact assessments (TIA), junction analysis, access planning, and traffic signage/road markings coordination. The role will support design development, authority approvals, and construction-phase traffic management in close coordination with highways, utilities, and construction teams. Key Responsibilities Lead delivery of Traffic Impact Assessments (TIA) and supporting technical studies for road and transport infrastructure projects (greenfield and brownfield). Develop and manage TTM / work zone traffic management deliverables, including: Diversion plans, detour layouts, staging/phasing plans, lane closure schemes, and construction access/egress arrangements Temporary signage and road marking plans, traffic control devices, safety barriers, and pedestrian management (where applicable) Methodology narratives, risk assessments, and sequencing aligned with construction methodology and site constraints Manage Dubai RTA coordination and approvals for TTM/diversions, including preparation of submission packages, responding to RTA comments, and aligning with RTA requirements, standards, and typical details. Perform junction and corridor analysis (existing and forecast), including capacity, LOS, queues, delays, and operational performance under base and construction-stage scenarios. Undertake traffic surveys scoping and interpretation: turning counts, mid-block counts, travel time runs, parking demand, pedestrian counts, heavy vehicle counts; develop calibrated base models where required. Develop traffic modelling and scenario testing for: Permanent scheme impacts (new intersections, access points, ramp terminals, weaving sections) Construction-stage impacts (temporary lane drops, detours, signal timing changes, partial closures) Mitigation measures (signal optimization, geometry refinements, temporary signal plans, reversible lanes where permissible) Prepare signage and road marking design inputs and reviews, including: Permanent guide signs, regulatory/warning signs, VMS interface needs (if applicable), and pavement marking strategy Temporary signage for work zones/diversions in accordance with RTA expectations and safety practice Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams: highways geometric design, utilities, structures, construction planning, safety, and stakeholder interfaces (developers, local authorities, police/ambulance access requirements where applicable). Provide construction support: review contractor TTM submissions, respond to RFIs, participate in site coordination meetings, and support implementation readiness checks. Prepare deliverables and governance documentation: design reports, TIA reports, concept/IFC drawings, phasing narratives, traffic management plans, and authority submission trackers. What do we need from you Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering / Transportation Engineering (Master’s preferred). 10+ years of experience in traffic engineering and transport planning with substantial exposure to: Dubai RTA processes for TTM/diversions and authority submissions (mandatory) Traffic impact assessments for major developments and infrastructure corridors Work zone traffic management, staging, and safe diversion planning on live roads Strong technical understanding of: Signalized/unsignalized intersection operations, corridor performance, access management Temporary traffic controls, pedestrian management, safety barriers, and staging constraints Traffic signage and pavement markings principles (temporary and permanent) Experience producing coordinated deliverables suitable for authority review and construction implementation, with strong QA/QC discipline. Preferable: exposure to Middle East standards and stakeholder management for constrained urban construction environments. What's in it for you? Software Traffic analysis / TIA: any combination of PTV VISSIM, Aimsun, SIDRA Intersection, Synchro/Sim Traffic, HCS (Highway Capacity Software). Junction / geometry checks: Auto TURN / Vehicle Tracking, basic swept path capability, parking and access evaluation tools. CAD / drawings: Auto CAD (mandatory); Civil 3D preferred for geometry coordination; Bluebeam for markups. GIS / data: QGIS / Arc GIS preferred; strong Excel capability for survey reduction and reporting. About the Role Role Overview : The Principal Geotechnical Engineer leads delivery of complex geotechnical scopes across building and infrastructure projects. The role carries technical authority over geotechnical design decisions, mentors a team of engineers, and serves as the primary geotechnical interface with clients, lead consultants, and specialist contractors. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Specifications Develop specifications for geotechnical investigation, topographic, geophysical, and remote sensing surveys. Prepare construction specifications covering earthworks, piling, embedded walls and shoring, earth retaining structures (MSE, gabion, nailed walls), ground improvement, slope stabilization, tie-back anchors, rock bolts, and dewatering systems. Prepare Instrumentation & Monitoring specifications including inclinometers, piezometers, and settlement plates. Technical Writing & Reports Prepare Geotechnical Interpretative Reports, Geotechnical Design Reports and Desk Study Reports. Develop geotechnical chapters within structural design reports. Developing pile load test interpretation reports, and contribute to technical proposals for tendering purposes. Review & Checking Review method statements against issued specifications, borehole logs, and laboratory testing programs. Review final GIR/GFR reports from soil laboratories and I&M data against trigger levels during construction. Review specialist contractor submissions covering shoring, dewatering design, piling, ground improvement, rock stabilization, and retaining wall designs. Conduct in-house QA/QC and external peer reviews of geotechnical deliverables. Serve as technical signatory for geotechnical deliverables and manage workstream scope, program, and fees. Attend and lead meetings with clients, lead consultants, sub-consultants, and contractors. Coordinate across structural, civil, and environmental disciplines on multidisciplinary projects. Contribute to business development, client relationship management, and technical proposal preparation. minimumQualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Communication Engineering or a related field
jobDescription:
About Us Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world. With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers. About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal ELV Engineer to join our team in Bengaluru, India. As a key technical leader in our organization, you will be responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and management of Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems for large-scale building projects. Lead the design and implementation of complex ELV systems, including building automation, fire alarm, security, telecommunications, and audio-visual systems Manage and mentor a team of ELV engineers, providing technical guidance and ensuring project success Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource allocations Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including architects, contractors, and clients, to ensure seamless integration of ELV systems Review and approve technical documentation, including drawings, specifications, and reports Ensure compliance with local and international building codes and standards Conduct site surveys and assessments to determine project requirements and constraints Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in ELV systems Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends in ELV systems Participate in business development activities and contribute to proposal preparation What do we need from you Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Communication Engineering or a related field Professional Engineering (PE) license preferred 10+ years of experience in ELV systems engineering, with a proven track record of successful large-scale projects Strong expertise in building automation, fire alarm, security, telecommunications, and audio-visual systems Proficiency in Auto CAD or similar CAD software, and experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) Excellent project management skills, including the ability to lead and mentor engineering teams In-depth knowledge of relevant building codes and standards Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, team members, and stakeholders Relevant certifications such as RCDD, CTS, or NICET are highly desirable Willingness to travel to project sites as needed Fluency in English; title: Facade Consultant
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree Architecture, Engineer or similar
jobDescription:
About Us Inhabit is a specialist consultancy focused on the design and advancement of the built environment. We are committed to making positive impact at global scale with human experience central to our activities. Our solutions-led approach provides Inhabit opportunities to work as creative design partners with acknowledged industry leaders in Architecture, Engineering and Sustainable Design from concept to completion. Our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society. Designing a sustainable future starts with diversity. At Inhabit, we’re committed to building that future, wherever in the world that may be. We recognise that it is only through diversity that we can create the best built environment possible, which is only accomplished in a climate of inclusion. If you share in this belief, we invite and encourage you to join us in constructing that future with Inhabit. About the Role An exciting opportunity in our Mumbai office is available for an experienced, creative, and motivated Façade Consultant to become part of the team. You will be collaborating with the best in the business, building on your specialised technical knowledge whilst working on the design of some of the most exciting projects in India and internationally. The Inhabit Consulting team is internationally distributed, and the team is location independent, enabling access to projects across Australia, Asia, US and Europe from any location. We uniquely work across all stages of the project lifecycle, from business case and advisory to sustainability and carbon strategy to detailed modelling, construction, and post-occupancy. This means that we have a focus on real-world results rather than the hypothetical targets seen in other parts of the sustainability industry. This role will see you working closely with other team members to carry out design engineering, project management and business development whilst also developing your own personal skills in design, engineering, and materials. Some of our recent Indian projects include: Aranya Residential Towers, Mumbai Noida Jewar Airport, New Delhi NCR Hindu Heritage Museum, Mangarh JSW Morena, Mumbai If this interests you, we are seeking someone who: Has an appetite for learning new skills and a proven ability to manage delivery of multiple projects Is motivated by progressive thinking to find creative solutions Has the growth mindset to grow and assist to scale the business to the next level Is curious and wants to apply problem-solving to real-world applications Doesn’t mind being out of their comfort zone and challenging themselves Is interested in continually refining their oral and written communication skills Understands the relationship between detail and the ‘bigger picture’, and has an appreciation for both Your typical day at Inhabit could involve: Contributing to the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e. structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.) Understanding of design and buildability of façade systems including material knowledge and installation techniques Coordinating with other project consultants such as Architects and Builders to determine best practice façade design outcomes Providing hand design sketches, develop reports for all stages of the project from conception to completion Developing façade system concepts based on architectural concepts Technical researching of materials and products Writing specifications and responding to site and construction related queries Assisting and coordinating with other members of the consulting team in the preparation of project deliverables Providing assistance during construction of façade systems including attendance mock-up testing, shop drawing reviews and conduct factory & site inspections What do we need from you Bachelor’s degree Architecture, Engineer or similar Ideally 4+ years’ experience in the façade industry in a similar role Extensive familiarity with façade systems, façade design, materials and fabrication / manufacture Proficiency in Auto CAD and Microsoft Office Knowledge of 3D design software (Rhino, Revit, Sketchup, etc.) Knowledge of 3D geometrical analysis (Grasshopper, Excel, etc.) Knowledge of graphics software (Affinity, In Design, etc.) Excellent communications skills both written and verbal Client and team focused Knowledge of relevant standards and codes for façades and services Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines Planning and organisational skills Be flexible to meet varied demands of the role What's in it for
